newsitem.title: USA: Ill. school district has Mercury losses - paper.
newsitem.headline: Ill. school district has Mercury losses - paper.

text.p: An Illinois school district sold short-term debt obligations linked to troubled Mercury Finance Co. this week at a loss of $74,000, Chicago Tribune reported Friday.
Elgin Unit District 46, which owned the obligations on its own and not through an investment pool, sold the debt before maturity to avoid losing more money, the paper said.
Last week, Cadre Financial Services Inc sold holdings of Mercury debt in investment pools it managed for school districts in Illinois and Michigan at no loss to the pools.

Earlier this month, Mercury, a Lake Forest, Ill., consumer finance company announced that it was in default on its short-term lending agreements after discovering accounting discrepancies that forced it to restate its last four year's earnings by about $90 million.
